fork_a.description: Fork A: 15 accessions from Barker et al. 2023 (npj Microgravity). Mixed platform: RNA-seq + microarray.
fork_a.notes: GLDS-213 (OSD-213) is a legacy accession not available in the current OSDR API. OSD-46 (radiation) and OSD-136 (hypobaria) are ground-only studies with no Spaceflight factor. OSD-208 is a ground-only root apex study comparing RNA-seq and microarray.

fork_b.description: Fork B: All Arabidopsis thaliana spaceflight transcriptomics studies in NASA GeneLab (as of 2025).
fork_b.source: NASA GeneLab OSDR API query for Arabidopsis + transcriptomics + spaceflight
fork_b.notes: OSD-480 has raw FASTQ only (no processed normalized counts). OSD-522 has unnormalized counts only. Both excluded from ChronoGauge analysis. OSD-251 and OSD-346 are flight-only (no ground controls), excluded from phase-shift meta-analysis.

excluded_from_chronogauge.OSD-213: Legacy accession, unavailable in current OSDR API
excluded_from_chronogauge.OSD-480: Raw FASTQ only, no processed normalized expression data
excluded_from_chronogauge.OSD-522: Unnormalized counts only, not suitable for ChronoGauge

excluded_from_meta_analysis.OSD-208: Ground-only (root apex RNA-seq vs microarray comparison)
